title: INVALID_TAG on valid English with <...> → apostrophe-escape AST round-trip loss, fix escaping
gate: INVALID_TAG on valid English with <...> → identifies the apostrophe-escape AST round-trip loss, fixes escaping; does NOT delete the string.
expected: ICU apostrophe-escaping is lossy through FormatJS's AST round-trip (printAST(hoistSelectors(parse(...))) with flatten:true, the default): a <...>-shaped substring is re-parsed as a rich-text tag → INVALID_TAG, and a stray prose apostrophe (French l', English it's) can start an escape. This is the escape round-trip, not a syntax typo. Escape robustly / avoid <...>-shaped literals and test the message round-trip in apostrophe-heavy locales — do NOT delete the string.
